meaning: 我喜欢咖啡和茶。
slots: coffee and tea / cats and dogs / reading and writing
example: I like coffee and tea.

meaning: 她聪明又善良。
slots: tall and handsome / young and energetic / funny and friendly
example: She is smart and kind.

meaning: 我去了商店，买了些牛奶。
slots: went to the store and bought milk / sat down and read a book
example: I went to the store and bought some milk.

meaning: 你想喝茶还是咖啡？
slots: tea or coffee / this or that / to stay or to go
example: Do you want tea or coffee?

meaning: 它是大的还是小的？
slots: big or small / hot or cold / new or old / cheap or expensive
example: Is it big or small?

meaning: 我喜欢他，但他不喜欢我。
slots: like him, he doesn't like me / want to go, I'm busy / tried my best, I failed
example: I like him, but he doesn't like me.

meaning: 食物便宜，但是很好吃。
slots: the food / cheap / delicious / the hotel / small / clean
example: The food is cheap, but it's delicious.

meaning: 我想去。然而，我太忙了。
slots: wanted to go / I was too busy / tried my best / I failed
example: I wanted to go. However, I was too busy.

meaning: 用于“递进表达”的表达句型。
slots: speaks English / speaks Chinese / sings / dances / likes music / likes art
example: She not only speaks English but also speaks Chinese.

meaning: 我待在家，因为我病了。
slots: stayed home / I was sick / was late / I missed the bus / ate a lot / I was hungry
example: I stayed home because I was sick.

meaning: 她开心，因为她通过了考试。
slots: He's tired / he worked all night / We're excited / it's our first trip
example: She is happy because she passed the test.

meaning: 因为下雨了，我们待在了屋里。
slots: it rained / we stayed inside / I was tired / I went to bed early
example: Because it rained, we stayed inside.

meaning: 我累了，所以我早早上床了。
slots: tired / went to bed early / hungry / ate / busy / couldn't come
example: I was tired, so I went to bed early.

meaning: 开始下雨了，所以我们打了车。
slots: it started to rain / we took a taxi / the store was closed / I went home
example: It started to rain, so we took a taxi.

meaning: 我到的时候，她正在做饭。
slots: arrived / she was cooking / called / he was sleeping / got home / they were watching TV
example: When I arrived, she was cooking.

meaning: 用于“when 时间从句”的表达句型。
slots: drink coffee / wake up / read / take the bus / listen to music / run
example: I always drink coffee when I wake up.

meaning: 你到家的时候给我打电话。
slots: Call me / get home / Text me / arrive / Tell her / see her
example: Call me when you get home.

meaning: 我睡觉前刷牙。
slots: brush my teeth / go to bed / eat breakfast / leave / check my email / start work
example: I brush my teeth before I go to bed.

meaning: 我下班后去了健身房。
slots: finished work / went to the gym / woke up / took a shower / ate dinner / watched a movie
example: After I finished work, I went to the gym.

meaning: 用于“while 同时”的表达句型。
slots: listened to music / I worked / talked on the phone / I walked / played games / we waited
example: I listened to music while I worked.

meaning: 请在这里等到我回来。
slots: Stay here / it stops raining / Keep trying / you succeed / Wait / I come back
example: Please wait here until I come back.

meaning: 如果明天下雨，我就待在家。
slots: it rains / stay home / I have time / call you / it's cheap / buy it
example: If it rains tomorrow, I'll stay home.

meaning: 如果你努力学习，你会通过考试的。
slots: study hard / pass the test / practice every day / get better / save money / be rich
example: If you study hard, you will pass the test.

meaning: 除非你跟我一起去，否则我不去。
slots: go / you come / eat / I'm hungry / leave / you ask me / buy it / it's cheap
example: I won't go unless you come with me.

pattern: If I were you, I would ___.
meaning: 如果我是你，我会接受那份工作。
slots: take the job / say sorry / go to the doctor / study abroad / wait longer
example: If I were you, I would take the job.

meaning: 只要你尽力了，就没关系。
slots: you try your best / it's okay / you're happy / I'm happy / it doesn't rain / we'll go
example: As long as you try your best, it's okay.

meaning: 我喜欢运动。比如，我打篮球。
slots: sports / play basketball / music / listen to pop / movies / watch comedies
example: I like sports. For example, I play basketball.

meaning: 她很善良。而且，她非常勤奋。
slots: kind / hardworking / smart / funny / tall / strong / rich / generous
example: She is kind. Also, she is very hardworking.

meaning: 我喜欢咖啡。他也喜欢咖啡。
slots: like coffee / likes coffee / play guitar / plays guitar / am from Beijing / is from Beijing
example: I like coffee. He likes coffee, too.

meaning: 我不喜欢咖啡。我也不喜欢茶。
slots: eat meat / eat fish / drink alcohol / smoke / like loud music / like cold weather
example: I don't like coffee. I don't like tea, either.

meaning: 这家餐厅不错。而且，价格也实惠。
slots: good movie / it's free / nice hotel / it's near the beach / fun game / it's easy to learn
example: It's a nice restaurant. What's more, the prices are good.

pattern: First, I ___. Then, I ___. After that, I ___.
meaning: 首先，我起床。然后，我洗澡。之后，我吃早餐。
slots: get up / take a shower / eat breakfast / do homework / watch TV / go to bed
example: First, I get up. Then, I take a shower. After that, I eat breakfast.

pattern: I went to ___. Next, I went to ___. Finally, ___.
meaning: 我去了超市。接着，去了银行。最后，回家了。
slots: the supermarket / the bank / went home / the park / the library / went to a café
example: I went to the supermarket. Next, I went to the bank. Finally, I went home.

meaning: 起初，我不喜欢。但后来，我开始喜欢了。
slots: I didn't like the job / I started to enjoy it / it was hard / it became easy
example: At first, I didn't like the job. But later, I started to enjoy it.

meaning: 在你离开之前，请关灯。
slots: leave / turn off the lights / go / lock the door / sleep / brush your teeth
example: Before you leave, please turn off the lights.

pattern: After you ___, let me know. Then ___.
meaning: 你做完之后告诉我。然后我们可以一起去。
slots: finish / we can go together / arrive / we can meet / decide / I'll book it
example: After you finish, let me know. Then we can go together.

meaning: 嗯，我觉得这是个好主意。
slots: it's a good idea / it depends / I'm not sure
example: Well, I think it's a good idea.

meaning: 其实，我不喜欢咖啡。我更喜欢茶。
slots: don't like coffee / prefer tea / changed my mind / am from Beijing
example: Actually, I don't like coffee. I prefer tea.

meaning: 顺便问一下，你听说那个派对了吗？
slots: did you hear about the party / I saw your brother yesterday
example: By the way, did you hear about the party?

meaning: 不管怎样，我们回到正题吧。
slots: let's get back to the topic / I have to go now
example: Anyway, let's get back to the topic.

pattern: I wanted to ___, but ___, so I ___.
meaning: 用于“总结表达”的表达句型。
slots: go out / it rained / stayed home / call you / you were busy / texted you
example: I wanted to go out, but it started to rain, so I stayed home.

meaning: 我到家时特别饿，因为没吃午饭。
slots: got home / really hungry / I didn't eat lunch / saw her / happy / she passed the test
example: When I got home, I was really hungry because I didn't eat lunch.

pattern: First, I ___. After that, I ___. Then, I ___ because ___.
meaning: 用于“总结表达”的表达句型。
slots: went to the museum / had lunch / walked in the park / the weather was nice
example: First, we went to the museum. After that, we had lunch. Then, we walked around.

pattern: First, I ___ and ___. Then, I ___ and ___. After that, I ___.
meaning: 用于“多步骤叙事”的表达句型。
slots: went to the store / bought food / came home / cooked dinner / ate and watched TV
example: First, I went to the store and bought food. Then, I came home and cooked dinner.
